notes.title: Hop Drop is part of Games Forged in Germany!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690448/2967a92bc962a7bdca7361c0ba6ac75860026096.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/p][p]The [b]Hop Drop[/b] launch feels like it was just yesterday — and we’ve already got some awesome news![/p][p]We're part of the [b]Games Forged in Germany[/b] event here on Steam![/p][p][b]Hop Drop[/b] is featured alongside a ton of other great titles from our fellow German devs and publishers.
Check out the event page and maybe grab a copy (or five) — there are [b]sweet discounts[/b] across the board:[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany[/url][/p][p][/p][p]And hey, if you already picked up [b]Hop Drop[/b]... Get another copy. Give it to a friend. Give it to your enemies. We can't keep living off dumpster scraps ːsteammockingː[/p][p][/p][p]Already grabbed [b]Hop Drop[/b]?[/p][p]Maybe even played it?[/p][p][b]Leave us a review![/b] It helps us way more than you think — and we promise not to cry while reading it. Probably.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3777690/Hop_Drop/?l=german"][/dynamiclink][/p][p] [b]Your Goon Squad Team [/b]❤️[/p]

notes.title: Hop Drop is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690448/4fad90ff6f06226771b6029b4ff44fd68140ab91.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]After months of coffee-fuelled chaos and way too many ragdoll test flights, we're thrilled to announce that [b]Hop Drop has officially launched on Steam![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Hop Drop[/b] is our first release as [b]Goon Squad[/b] - four indies trying to ship small and entertaining games in a short amount of time. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690448/369d02e2eb7ea1c0302bf44b24e64577968c7265.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]What's waiting for you:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Pure arcade action - Jump-charged stilts that sling-shot you across rooftops, parks, beaches, and flying cars[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple difficulties - Easy, Medium, and Hard deliveries with escalating payout... and panic.[/p][/*][*][p]Friend Leaderboards - Compete with friends and see how you stack up[/p][/*][*][p]Tight 5-minute loops: Perfect for "one more try" sessions and speed runs.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]How you can help us:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Play & post a review - Steam's algorithm loves early feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Share your clips - tag @GoonSquadDev on X or drop them in the Community Hub.[/p][/*][*][p]Tell us what's missing - ideas, bugs, crazy tricks we haven't thought of? Feel free to put it in the Steam forum or join us on our [url="https://discord.gg/hBANYnRAe7"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][/olist][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690448/e39067605b1b659029c081cbb65390ad3d9dd8af.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for taking this leap with us (literally). Now strap on those jumping stilts, deliver some organs, and claim that #1 spot![/p][p][/p][p]- Team Goon Squad ❤️[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3777690/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
